    AI-Driven Exercise Performance and Form Intelligence System

    AI-Driven Exercise Performance and Form Intelligence System

    Accessible exercise assistance using a laptop and webcam.

    Exercise assistance

    Webcam pose detection, exercise-specific rules, repetition counting, real-time visual and spoken feedback, customizable voice coaching, and workout history.

    Six ways to train

    Squats, bicep curls, push-ups, shoulder presses and pull-ups track complete elbow or knee movements. Plank measures aligned hold time. Each exercise includes an animated guide.

    Private by design

    Camera analysis runs on your device. Session summaries and voice preferences stay in this browser.

    Ready without Wi-Fi

    Download the offline pack before disconnecting. It includes the app, pose model and all six guides. Choose an installed offline voice for spoken cues. Clearing browser storage removes your downloaded pack and history.

    Choose exercise→Check your frame→Move with feedback→Review your session
